title: Quarterly tenant migration & activation gates: operationalization plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Create a playbook and quarter-level roadmap for activating private/VPC/on-prem tenants with clear gating criteria, rollback paths, and monitoring so that we can onboard 10 mid-market customers without manual escalation. This ticket covers cross-functional tasks: compatibility verification tooling, activation gates, deprecation/migration windows, customer comms templates, and post-activation QA checks. Outcome: a runnable checklist, automation scripts, and a staging-to-production activation run executed in two pilot cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: A runbook exists in Confluence titled 'Quarterly Tenant Activation Runbook' with step-by-step activation and rollback procedures
Compatibility-verifier (cv-service) integration built and run against 3 representative customer manifests
Automated preflight checks and feature-flag gating in LaunchDarkly hook into activation flow
Two pilot activations completed with documented learnings and <3 action items remaining
Operational dashboards (Grafana) show onboarding health: activation_success_rate, p95_latency, error_budget_consumption
Playbook includes explicit SLA gating thresholds and a deprecation/migration calendar for incompatible features
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Prep (2 weeks) - finalize runbook, add preflight checks, and schedule pilot cohorts. Phase 1: Pilot Cohort A (2 weeks) - run 3 customers in staging, collect telemetry and refine rollback scripts. Phase 2: Pilot Cohort B (3 weeks) - run 5 customers in canary-like production lanes with guardrails. Phase 3: Scale (ongoing) - expand to remaining customers, instrument telemetry alerts, and hold weekly activation retro for the quarter. Each phase has a hard stop if activation_success_rate < 90% or p95 latency degrades > 20% relative to baseline.
kpis: onboarding engineering effort per tenant <= 8 engineer-hours after automation
risks: Hidden incompatible customer network topologies causing private-agent handshake failures
Model/quantization variant drift across dedicated vs private runtime leading to quality regressions
Insufficient observability for cross-tenant resource contention during surge activations
Operational burden on infra team if activation scripts are brittle or manual steps remain

ENG-15321: Private agent image signing and KMS key rotation support
